children: CoinGlass data shows that whales on Hyperliquid currently hold $8.06 billion in positions, with a long-to-short ratio of 0.87. According to ChainCatcher, long positions total $3.76 billion, or 46.63% of holdings, while short positions total $4.30 billion, or 53.37%. Long positions have $158 million in profit and loss, while short positions show a loss of $117 million.
A whale address, 0x5b5d..60, is short ETH with 5x cross margin at $2,322.65 and has an unrealized loss of $8.88 million.
